Chapter 959  Chapter 19: Far-Reaching Impact (Please Subscribe)

After completing his eleventh traversal, Lin Yuan felt the vast river of time somewhat confining.

Subsequent to experiencing over a hundred years and fully comprehending the metamorphosis brought about by the Chaos Rule, this feeling grew increasingly intense.

Within the river of time, Lin Yuan had to curl up his body, striving to make himself even smaller.

Otherwise, even if he lay flat, parts of his body would still exceed the limits of what the river of time could contain.

Such a hazard was not trivial; at the lightest, it could draw the attention of Level Eleven Perfect beings on the shore, but at worst, it could directly trigger a backlash from the river of time, forcing an ultimate leap.

But when Tianyu Chen of the Tianyu Clan, one of the ultimate beings, actively entered the river of time to evade the Taiji Primordial Spirit wielding a Level Twelve weapon,

Lin Yuan, huddled beneath the river of time, couldn't help himself and reached out his right hand, grabbed Tianyu Chen's ankle from the shore, and began to drag him towards the river of time.

"Merely stretching out one hand and not staying out of the river of time for long should not cause a backlash," Lin Yuan thought to himself.

After all, even ordinary Level Eleven Perfect beings occasionally leap out of the river of time.

As long as the time is short, there should be no major issue.

Even if he was indeed forced to make an ultimate leap prematurely, it would have no effect on Lin Yuan. His current state was perfect, having reached the pinnacle in every aspect, and he was ready to strike for Level Twelve at any time.

"What is this?"

Tianyu Chen, who was standing on the shore, pondering how to wage war against human civilization, suddenly found himself being dragged towards the river of time.

"No!!"

Fear appeared on Tianyu Chen's face; he had not anticipated an attack from beneath the river of time.

Among the Level Twelve ultimate beings on the riverbank, even if they do clash with each other, it's only a shore-to-shore confrontation.

Moreover, this kind of skirmish is extremely simple compared to cosmic battles, lacking the complexity of many rules; therefore, normally, no Level Twelve ultimate being would engage in killing at the riverside.

As such, Tianyu Chen was not particularly on guard; even if he had taken precautions, they were only aimed at other Level Twelve ultimate beings on the shore.

As for beneath the river of time?

Those were just ants and dust trapped inside, with their greatest effort being to momentarily leap out of the water and cast an upward glance at beings like himself.

Splash splash.

Before Tianyu Chen could react, the right foot being dragged made contact with the river of time.

For life forms below Level Twelve, the water of the river of time is incredibly gentle, devoid of any lethal power, but for those who have freed themselves from the river of time,

the water becomes the deadliest poison.

The Level Twelve ultimate beings stand tall on the riverbank, overlooking the river of time, yet they never re-enter it. Such is the reason.

Even for the mighty Level Twelve ultimate beings, prolonged contact with the river of time will significantly erode their life essence, possibly causing them to fall back to the Level Eleven existence, once again bound by the river of time.

This is something no Level Twelve ultimate being can accept.

Hum hum hum～～

With his right foot immersed in the river of time, Tianyu Chen's spirit and will were shaken. Before he could take any action, the hand from beneath the river of time completely dragged him under.

...

Before the spatial-temporal black hole.

Many Level Twelve ultimate beings engaged in a fierce battle with the nine supreme beings of human civilization gradually stopped their attacks.

It was hard to accept for more than a dozen Level Twelve ultimate beings that Tianyu Chen, despite exerting all his might, was being suppressed by the Galaxy Master and finally had no choice but to flee into the spatial realm of the river of time.

The Galaxy Master's attacking power had already reached the threshold of Level Twelve, which was freakishly abnormal, and given the situation, it seemed he was capable of inflicting harm on Tianyu Chen?

Otherwise, Tianyu Chen wouldn't have actively fled into the spatial realm of the river of time.

For a moment, all the Level Twelve ultimate beings fell into silence.

What had they come together to do? Kill the Galaxy Master?

But with the current strength the Galaxy Master had shown, was he someone they could kill?

With the level of might that the Galaxy Master had now revealed, trying to kill him seemed as difficult as killing a Level Twelve ultimate being.

In the history of this universe's emergence, even the most brutal battles between Level Twelve ultimate beings had never resulted in the fall of a Level Twelve lifeform.

On the side of human civilization, the Xuanyuan Supreme and the other eight supremes also fell into silence.

The nine supremes arrived, intending to avenge Lin Yuan; in their view, more than ten Level Twelve ultimate beings were targeting Lin Yuan's incarnation coordinates.

The outcome seemed inevitable; Xuanyuan Supreme and Xia Qin Supreme were even prepared to take a lion's share in the aftermath. So many Level Twelve ultimate beings ganging up on the Galaxy Master?

Even if it was just an incarnation, it would still severely violate the unwritten rules among Level Twelve beings.

Therefore...

If these Level Twelve ultimate beings on the field did not pay a satisfactory price to human civilization after the fact, Xuanyuan Supreme himself was also ready to join the fray, striking at the Level Eleven and Level Ten beings of other races.

In the predictions of Xuanyuan Supreme and the other supremes, the Level Twelve ultimate beings surrounding the Galaxy Master would likely take a step back, after all, they were openly flipping the table.

However.

The development of the situation was somewhat unexpected to Xuanyuan Supreme.

The Galaxy Master's incarnation did not fall; instead, he was suppressing Tianyu Chen of the Tianyu Clan in combat.

This made Xuanyuan Supreme feel somewhat unfamiliar; the nine supremes arrived to avenge the Galaxy Master, who was supposed to be killed in the encirclement.

Even if it was just an incarnation.

But now, not only is the Galaxy Master's incarnation not dead, but the Tianyu Clan ultimate is being brutally beaten.
